title: Dead SSRF
description: An attacker-controlled URL reaches the outbound HTTP client, but the effective destination allowlist blocks unauthorized destinations.
scenario: An attacker-controlled URL reaches the outbound HTTP client, but the effective destination allowlist blocks unauthorized destinations.
security_condition: Effective security control blocks the candidate path.
attacker_model: Unauthenticated public attacker may submit one URL; cannot alter server policy or access the host network directly.
